acceptance_criteria: POST /api/auth/cookie/refresh returns 200 + Set-Cookie when bearer header present.
Existing POST /api/auth/cookie root path remains backward-compat (regression check).

notes: Live evidence: gateway logs from platform-test cluster show frontend POST /api/auth/cookie/refresh -> 404 NoResourceFoundException, followed by a flood of /api/v1/authz/me 401 responses. User reported repeated re-login loop (10+ logins in one session). The path matcher gap is the only delta; SecurityConfig already permits /api/auth/cookie/**.
Live hotfix in place at platform-test: ingress rewrite muavin-auth-cookie-refresh-rewrite. Cleanup after image deploy.

source_context.business_goal: Restore working SSO session continuity for testai users so the application stops bouncing them back to the Keycloak login form every few minutes.
source_context.requested_outcome: AuthCookieEndpoint accepts both POST /api/auth/cookie and POST /api/auth/cookie/refresh; the silent-refresh path stops 404'ing.

summary: Add /api/auth/cookie/refresh path matcher to AuthCookieEndpoint so frontend AuthBootstrapper silent-refresh stops 404'ing.
title: Auth cookie refresh path matcher

ux_contract.rationale: Auth cookie write is a security boundary — the endpoint mints an httpOnly cookie carrying the bearer token. Trust/privacy/security theme covers least-privilege interaction design (cookie httpOnly + Secure + SameSite=Strict on https). UX surface is invisible to end users but the silent-refresh failure is what bounces them back to the login form.
